# ClickPDF

> A browser-based PDF toolkit by Click Digital Services.

## Overview

ClickPDF provides 21 browser-based tools for merging, splitting, compressing, converting, organizing, editing, and protecting PDF documents. For supported PDF tools, document file contents are processed locally in your browser on your device rather than uploaded to ClickPDF's document-processing service. This describes document processing only: the website may still make standard network requests for its code, fonts, workers, images, and other page resources. Enabled advertising or other third-party features may also make standard requests and receive associated connection metadata under their own policies. This is not a claim of zero network traffic or anonymity. Processing capacity depends on the tool, browser, device memory, and file size.

## PDF tools

- [Merge PDF Files Online — 100% Free & In-Browser](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/merge-pdf/): Merge PDF files online for free with drag-and-drop reordering. Supported files are processed in your browser; the page may still make network requests.
- [Split PDF Online — Extract Pages into Separate Files Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/split-pdf/): Split PDF files into individual pages or custom ranges for free. Client-side extraction processes selected files locally in your browser.
- [Compress PDF Online — Reduce File Size in Your Browser](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/compress-pdf/): Reduce PDF file size online while preserving readability. Free, client-side compression processes selected files locally in your browser.
- [Convert Images to PDF Online — JPG, PNG & WebP to PDF](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/image-to-pdf/): Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images to high-resolution PDF files online for free. Fast in-browser conversion with local processing and custom page orientation.
- [Convert PDF to Images Online — Export PDF Pages as PNG](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/pdf-to-image/): Export PDF pages as PNG images in your browser. Select multiple PDFs, reorder, rotate, copy, or remove pages, then download a ZIP.
- [Rotate PDF Online — Permanently Rotate PDF Pages Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/rotate-pdf/): Rotate PDF pages or entire documents clockwise or counter-clockwise in your browser, with a visual preview and instant download.
- [Watermark PDF Online — Add Confidential & Custom Marks Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/watermark-pdf/): Add custom text watermarks to PDF documents for free. Adjust text, opacity, angle, and position in your browser; the page may still make network requests.
- [Add Page Numbers to PDF Online — Free In-Browser Pagination](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/page-numbers-pdf/): Insert page numbering (e.g. Page 1 of N) into PDF headers or footers online for free. Page resources and enabled services may still make network requests.
- [Organize PDF Pages Online — Reorder, Rotate & Delete Pages](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/organize-pdf/): Reorder, delete, and rotate PDF pages in your browser with drag-and-drop. Page resources and enabled services may still make requests.
- [Edit PDF Metadata Online — Modify Author, Title & Properties](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/edit-pdf-metadata/): Inspect or edit PDF properties such as Title, Author, Subject, and Producer in your browser. The page may still request resources or enabled services.
- [In-Browser PDF OCR, Page Counter & Text Analysis](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/ocr-pdf-analysis/): Extract text from scanned PDF images with in-browser Tesseract.js OCR, count pages, and inspect document dimensions. Supported files are processed locally.
- [Protect PDF Online — Web Crypto AES-256 Password Encryption](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/protect-pdf-password/): Password-protect PDFs with browser Web Crypto AES-256. Document encryption runs locally; the page may still request site resources or third-party services.
- [Unlock PDF Online — Decrypt Password-Protected Documents Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/unlock-pdf-password/): Unlock password-protected PDFs online for free with Web Crypto in your browser. Page resources and enabled services may make requests.
- [Convert PDF to Text & Markdown Online — Free Text Extraction](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/pdf-to-text/): Extract formatted plain text and Markdown from PDFs for free. Text extraction runs locally in your browser on the selected document.
- [PDF to Word (DOCX) Converter — 100% Free & In-Browser](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/pdf-to-word/): Convert PDFs to editable Word (.docx) with browser-based text extraction for headings and formatting. Selected files are processed locally.
- [PDF to Excel (XLSX) Converter — Extract Tables Online Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/pdf-to-excel/): Convert PDF tables, statements, and receipts to Excel (.xlsx) with in-browser table detection; selected files are processed locally.
- [PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX) Converter — 100% Free & In-Browser](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/pdf-to-powerpoint/): Convert PDF pages into editable PowerPoint (.pptx) slides in the browser with a 16:9 layout; selected files are processed locally.
- [Word to PDF Converter Online — Free DOCX to PDF In-Browser](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/word-to-pdf/): Convert Word (.docx) documents to readable, high-resolution PDF pages in your browser. Tables, lists, and embedded images are supported locally.
- [Word to Excel Converter — Extract DOCX Tables to XLSX](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/word-to-excel/): Extract tables and text from Word (.docx) files into an Excel workbook in your browser. Each table gets a worksheet; page requests may still occur.
- [Excel to PDF Converter Online — Paginated Tables Free](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/excel-to-pdf/): Convert Excel (.xlsx, .xls, .csv) to styled PDF tables in your browser. Auto-fit columns and row styling; page requests may still occur.
- [Add a Visual Signature to PDF — Draw, Type or Upload](https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/sign-pdf-online/): Draw, type, or upload a visual signature mark and embed it into PDF pages in your browser. Files and signature images stay on your device.
